Synopsis:
Over 72,000 migrants crossed from Morocco into Ceuta (Spanish EU enclave) on July 30-31, killing at least 100. PM Sanchez attributes the surge to disinformation spread via social media, blaming Russian and Israeli networks — not Morocco. Israel's FM flatly denied this. ~5,000 migrants remain in Ceuta, causing local unrest. Spain is deploying €348M in emergency and recovery funds for the enclave.
